name: @neo4j-nvl/react
notes: Proprietary Neo4j client software. Publisher lists no repository. ESM syntax in .js under a commonjs package with extensionless imports, so Node require and import both fail; a bundler is required. React peer is 18.0.0 || ^19.0.0, which excludes React 18.2/18.3.

build_vs_buy.effort: 6-12 months for a WebGL graph renderer with layouts
build_vs_buy.rationale: The capability is a buy; choose an open-source vendor if the licence does not fit.

prior_versions.note: Same proprietary licence, no repository, no provenance and the same bundler-only packaging. Layout stack differs: cytoscape 3.33.1 + @neo4j-bloom/dagre 0.8.14 instead of @dagrejs/dagre. Install measured at 56.3 MB / 94 packages.
